answer: New identities start at the nadir, and climbing to zenith requires sustained honest work across many epochs. Each agent must stake a bond that rises with reputation earned over time. When a sybil cluster is detected, slashed bonds flood the reward pool, turning the tide against attackers: faking thousands of identities costs real capital, while honest participants recover their stake plus a share of the forfeited funds. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
